description: Fires when the opponent's last stone was dropped into column 1 and I have no stone in column 1: strongest (up to ~7) when it is the first stone in column 1 at 4 stones, weaker later in the game. A second column-1 stone fires only early and only if both are theirs; any stone of mine in column 1 suppresses it. Weak near-threshold firing also on 4-stone openings with four different columns and column 1 empty.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves column probabilities by at most ~5 points on 5 positions tested.
notes: Layer-0 unit, essentially a 'fresh move into column 1' detector with ply decay. p1 (first col1 stone) F1 0.79; adding ply-4 distinct-column openings F1 0.83; adding early second col1 stone when both theirs F1 0.857 (P .90 R .82, AUROC .91), sim share 0.70. Remaining errors are ply-4 openings hovering around the threshold (1.3-1.75) and late-game second col1 stones whose earlier col1 stone is far back. Minimal pairs: 3,3,3,3,1 3.4 vs +1 -2.0; ...5,5 +0/2/6 ~0.2 vs +1 2.1. Synthesis 3,5,4,1 = 7.565 beats dev max.
